purpose: custom sprite import testing only; excluded from app bundle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for testing a desktop companion's custom animation importer. Create an ORIGINAL adorable young ADULT female office worker, chibi Japanese healing manga hand-drawn watercolor with warm brown pencil outlines. Chestnut shoulder-length bob hair with a tiny peach hair clip, big expressive brown eyes, round thin glasses, rosy cheeks, modest cream blouse with sage-green cardigan and navy trousers, soft socks. Sitting cross-legged with a small peach-pink laptop on her lap. Same character, outfit, fixed camera, body scale and foot anchor in every frame. Polished charming illustration, not 3D or pixel art.
CRITICAL PRODUCTION LAYOUT: exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, 6 equal columns x 4 equal rows, 24 equal 256 x 256 cells. One full character per cell, no visible cell borders. Everything including hair, laptop, hands and small effects MUST fit the central 180 x 180 region of EACH cell (at least 38 px completely clear transparent margin on all sides). Fixed foot baseline at 215 px inside each cell. Never overlap neighboring cells. ALL cells equally sized, no title area. Genuine alpha transparency throughout the empty background, no colored backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no ground shadows, no text, captions, labels or watermark.
Four separate six-frame action loops, frames run left-to-right within each row:
ROW 1: working very hard on laptop. 1 attentive face fingers ready;2 left hand types head leans forward;3 both hands typing quickly;4 determined cheeks puffed small brow furrow fingers changed;5 right hand types head slightly tilts;6 eases back toward frame1. Tiny motion strokes only, laptop fixed.
ROW 2: thinking. 1 looks up from laptop;2 hand to chin;3 head tilted and eyes looking up;4 eyes brighten a SMALL lightbulb appears near head;5 delighted little raised index finger;6 lowers hand back toward neutral. Keep bulb INSIDE the cell.
ROW 3: exhausted then recovering. 1 shoulders slump;2 sleepy half-closed eyes;3 head lowered resting near laptop;4 tiny yawn one hand covering mouth;5 gently rubs an eye;6 sits back up. Gentle cute fatigue, no extra spirit character.
ROW 4: happy finishing work. 1 hands on open laptop;2 begins closing laptop;3 laptop closed on lap soft smile;4 lifts arms into a small happy stretch eyes closed;5 brings arms down with cheerful smile;6 hands return to laptop ready to reopen. No chair or desk. Each row is a coherent incremental animation, not six unrelated illustrations. Strong character consistency and visibly changing poses. Clear wide gutters are more important than filling the canvas.
